en.t: Can it not be changed simply because it is history?

units.source_text: 过去的所有历史都在改变嘛。

en.t: All of history from the past is changing, after all.

units.source_text: 只要有具有改变力量的人……

en.t: As long as there are people with the power to change it...

units.source_text: 现在在美国，像我这样的人也为了争取妇女参政权而活动，

en.t: Now in America, people like me are also campaigning to win women's suffrage,
and this kind of movement may succeed.

units.source_text: 一想到还存在像埃及这样把女人当奴隶看待的国家，作为个人就无法沉默。”

en.t: When I think that countries like Egypt still exist, treating women as slaves, I cannot remain silent as an individual.
